articles.excerpt: STATERA Library · Series 09 · Volume 01 · Chapter 05 · EN https://github.com/Statera-Library/09_Vol_01_Physical_AI_Foundations_and_Engineering/blob/main/Chapter_05_Decision_Making_and_Reasoning/Chapte…
articles.body: STATERA Library · Series 09 · Volume 01 · Chapter 05 · EN Source: https://github.com/Statera-Library/09_Vol_01_Physical_AI_Foundations_and_Engineering/blob/main/Chapter_05_Decision_Making_and_Reasoning/Chapter_05_Decision_Making_and_Reasoning_EN.md Physical AI Engineering Chapter 05 Decision Making and Reasoning 05-01 Task Planning Task Planning is one of the fundamental capabilities that distinguishes Physical AI from conventional automation systems. While traditional robots execute predefined sequences of commands, Physical AI systems must determine what actions should be performed, in what order they should occur, under which constraints they should be executed, and how they should adapt when unexpected events occur.

articles.excerpt: STATERA Library · Series 09 · Volume 01 · Chapter 06 · EN https://github.com/Statera-Library/09_Vol_01_Physical_AI_Foundations_and_Engineering/blob/main/Chapter_06_Control_and_Actuation/Chapter_06_Con…
articles.body: STATERA Library · Series 09 · Volume 01 · Chapter 06 · EN Source: https://github.com/Statera-Library/09_Vol_01_Physical_AI_Foundations_and_Engineering/blob/main/Chapter_06_Control_and_Actuation/Chapter_06_Control_and_Actuation_EN.md Physical AI Engineering Chapter 06 Control and Actuation 06-01 Control Theory Control Theory forms one of the most fundamental scientific and engineering disciplines underlying Physical AI, robotics, autonomous systems, intelligent vehicles, industrial automation, aerospace systems, and cyber-physical systems. Every intelligent physical agent must continuously perceive the surrounding environment, estimate its current state, determine an appropriate response, and generate control commands that drive actuators toward desired objectives.

articles.excerpt: The wildly ambitious campaign takes generations
articles.body: Licensed tabletop role-playing games provide players with a new way to experience their favorite franchises like Star Wars , Star Trek, and the Lord of the Rings . But those adventures always come with a big question about how player characters are supposed to make their mark on stories that already have their own legendary heroes. articles.title: No more asteroid landing: Engine trouble forces Japan's Hayabusa2 probe to change plans
articles.excerpt: Japan's space agency has decided to switch destinations and objectives for the final act of its Hayabusa2 asteroid mission, due to problems with the spacecraft's ion thrusters.
articles.body: Japan's space agency has decided to switch destinations and objectives for the final act of its Hayabusa2 mission, due to the spacecraft suffering trouble with its ion thrusters. The veteran Hayabusa2 spacecraft launched back in 2014 to collect material from the asteroid Ryugu . Since delivering the samples to Earth in December 2020 via a reentry capsule, the main spacecraft has been conducting an extended mission of exploration and in July made a super-close flyby of the two-headed asteroid Torifune. But Hayabusa2's continued adventures are now set for a premature end.

articles.title: China rolls out rocket for launch of 1st international astronaut to Tiangong space station (video)
articles.excerpt: China has rolled to the launch pad the rocket and spacecraft for its Shenzhou-24 mission, which will fly the first international astronaut to the nation's Tiangong space station.
articles.body: China's space station is set to receive its first foreign astronaut. A Long March 2F rocket, topped with the Shenzhou-24 crew spacecraft, was rolled out to the pad at Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center in northwest China, on Tuesday (Nov. 17), with launch expected in the next week. The 191-foot-tall (58 meters) rocket was transferred 0.93 miles (1.5 kilometers) from a vertical integration building to the pad over the course of around two hours, starting around 4 a.m. EST (0900 GMT, or 5 p.m. Beijing Time), according to China Central Television (CCTV). China rolls out the Long March 2F rocket for its Shenzhou-24 astronaut mission on Nov. 17, 2026.

articles.title: Don't miss Saturn shine close to the moon on Nov. 20
articles.excerpt: The moon shines with Saturn in the constellation Pisces after sunset on Nov. 20
articles.body: The moon shines close to the ringed giant Saturn after sunset on Nov. 20, presenting a spectacular naked-eye display as the stars of the Great Square of Pegasus twinkle nearby. Saturn's steady light will appear a little over 5 degrees from the 82%-lit moon in the southeastern sky after the sun dips below the horizon for viewers in the U.S. — roughly the width of your three middle fingers held at arm's length. Moonlight will hide fainter stars from view, though you should be able to spot Algenib, Markab, Alpheratz and Scheat arrayed in a diamond formation above the lunar disk, marking out the asterism of the Great Square of Pegasus in the November sky.
